entries.172c221372ce6ed7: A platform for corporate customers to utilize generative AI. entries.25dd8ce1e0622a60: A business support tool specialized in responding to inquiries from inside and outside the company. By accumulating conversation logs and improving answer accuracy through AI machine learning, it automates part of the work that people previously handled by phone or email. No separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.3dba670a1a1ca5dd: This is a comprehensive digital marketing tool that supports the operation of Web sites. It has functions such as automatic content creation by generative AI, visualization of user behavior through heat maps, and pop-up delivery to prevent drop-offs and improve conversion. There is no separate disclosure of the amount.
entries.46711f4ed87d8522: This is a single-segment business that provides platform services using big data and artificial intelligence (AI). It provides "User Insight," a comprehensive digital marketing tool that supports Web site operation, "Social Insight," a social media analysis tool, "Support Chatbot," a tool supporting inquiry responses, "User Local ChatAI," a generative AI tool for corporations, and others. All are provided in SaaS form, and are structured so that, as use increases, data accumulates and leads to improvements in AI accuracy and analysis capabilities. Net sales for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥5,343 million.
